## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 8, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Daniel Dieckmann_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "don't know what happened, app has been working fine for years, now I can't use the me button to view any of my past activities or see anything about my stats. anytime you press that button, the app closes and crashes instantly. my phone tells me that the app has a bug. it crashes every single time. after years and while having a paid subscription."
            2. _Gea Saarepera_, Jul 12, 2026, 1/5: "Activities are not uploading to the app from Garmin. seems to be the only app I'm having issues with. it's not that none come through, nope, totally random ones seem to be missing. I have disconnected Garmin from it and then reconnected. no chance. definitely not renewing the subscription, not worth the hassle"
            3. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, Apr 8, 2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats asics."
